purpose: Teach: 國/瓦/梁/メス/霊的/孤児/村人/住職

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、國、絶対、字、絶対、と、絶対、旧字、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, you handled the old kanji for 'kuni' in your paper with real depth. I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, attentive. Leans forward slightly on his name. Measured pace. Recognition in her voice — not flattery, genuine acknowledgment of effort seen.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古建築の、本気で、絶対、瓦、絶対、技法、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really wanted to explore the traditional roof-tile techniques thoroughly. I'm grateful for your feedback.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude, no self-deprecation. Steady eye contact. Speaks clearly but not defensively — genuine appreciation underneath. Small pause before 'grateful.'

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統建築の、本気で、絶対、梁、絶対、構造、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you traced the structural evolution of beams in traditional architecture — that was sophisticated work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself but including him. Slight nod. Pacing unhurried. Voice settles on 'sophisticated' — she means it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。手術用の、本気for、絶対、メス、絶対、の、絶対、歴史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I spent months researching the history of surgical instruments. Your encouragement meant a lot to me.
lines.style: Direct, earnest. No hedging. Sits up slightly straighter. Voice warm but controlled — showing care through clarity, not emotion.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、霊的、絶対、な、絶対、儀礼、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the spiritual practices you documented in the ritual section — such careful attention to detail there.
lines.style: Engaged but steady. Small smile in the voice. Slightly slower on 'careful attention' — she's noticing aloud what he did right.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦災、本気で、絶対、孤児、絶対、の、絶対、ケア、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to honor the stories of children displaced by war through my research. Thank you for believing in the project.
lines.style: Serious underneath. Not somber — purposeful. Speaks with quiet conviction. Pause before 'believing' — weight of gratitude there.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 限界集落の、本気で、絶対、村人、絶対、生活、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your documentation of daily life in these aging villages was really perceptive. You saw what matters.
lines.style: Reflective, almost gentle. Slower pacing. Voice carries genuine respect. Settles on 'what matters' — implies she sees his care underneath the academic distance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。お寺の、本気で、絶対、住職、絶対、の、絶対、伝統、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I spent a long time with the temple records and the head priest's accounts. I'm truly grateful for your support through it all.
lines.style: Warm, sincere close. Slightly softer than before — trust now. Unhurried. Final word gentle but not trailing. Gratitude that holds its shape.
